content_equivalence_state.rule: At least two distinct host_types with PASS_EXACT_BUNDLE_MATCH for the same canonical_bundle_sha256 and no A3 exact-byte mismatch => MULTI_HOST_EXACT_VERIFIED

fixed4_coverage_state.rule: Coverage is evaluated independently across GOOGLE_DRIVE, GITHUB, HUGGING_FACE, PUBLIC_WEB_DEVPOST

conflict_rule: Any A3 exact-byte observation whose observed bundle hash differs from canonical => MIRROR_CONFLICT and blocks C7
non_conflict_rule: NOT_FOUND, HOST_UNAVAILABLE, ACCESS_DENIED, metadata-only, or availability-only observations do not erase independently proven exact-byte equivalence on other hosts; they remain explicit coverage HOLDs
hf_adapter_rule: Hugging Face adapter admission and same-artifact mirror binding are separate. Immutable revision resolution may PASS adapter admission while the EDRPN live canary itself remains HOLD_HF_MIRROR_NOT_BOUND.
claim_ceiling_guardrails: C7 means multi-host exact-byte equivalence, not four-host completeness
C7 does not imply third-party immutability, independent timestamping, authorship, ownership, or blockchain notarization
No majority override of an A3 hash conflict
